title: Two small lists meet at the target
hook: The missing half of a subset can be searched by its required sum.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Solve subset sum by enumerating half-subset sums and matching complements.

misconception: Every exact subset-sum search must enumerate all full subsets.
objective: Solve subset sum by enumerating half-subset sums and matching complements.

claims.text: Each full subset splits uniquely into one left subset and one right subset. Enumerating half sums and matching the target minus each left sum searches these combinations through complementary values, rather than enumerating every full subset directly.
